blocks.task_summary: Show that the line through B and C is y = (-m^3/8 + n)x
method_path: Find slope from B(0,0) and C(m/2, -m^4/16 + nm/2)
accepted_alternatives: Working backwards to verify points lie on line (awarded at most M1A0)

blocks.task_summary: Show that the other intersection point A has x-coordinate m/4 - (m/4)√5.
method_path: Equate quartic and line to form polynomial equation.
Factor out x and (x - m/2) from the quartic.
Apply quadratic formula to get x = m/4 ± (m/4)√5.
Select the smaller root x_A = m/4 - (m/4)√5.
accepted_alternatives: Method 2: Form cubic factor, use sum and product of roots with known root x_C = m/2 to derive quadratic, then solve.
